wheel.title: The Wheel of Peel

won.firework: You won a firework. It’s in your pocket: launch it here on the square.
won.lure: You won a lure. It’s in your pocket, and it works at the beach pier.
won.peel: A banana peel. Nothing, but it was a good spin.

wheel.full: Your pocket already holds five of those, so Spinner pays you {n} coins instead.
wheel.funds: A spin costs {n} coins, and you have {have}.
wheel.cap: That’s all the spins Spinner takes from you today. Your free one is back tomorrow.
wheel.busy: The wheel stuck. Nothing was spent, so try again in a moment.
wheel.keep: Spins are kept on your Banana Pass, and this device doesn’t have one yet.
wheel.potWon: {name} just won THE POT at the Wheel of Peel: {n} coins.
wheel.potWonAnon: Somebody just won THE POT at the Wheel of Peel: {n} coins.

exchange.title: The Exchange
exchange.rumourUp: Bean at the café says eggs go up tomorrow. He is usually right.
exchange.rumourDown: Bean at the café says eggs drop tomorrow. He is usually right.
exchange.paid: Fig Jr. paid you {coins} coins for {n} {what}.
exchange.none: Nothing to sell yet. Your homestead’s hens, goats, cows and sheep make the eggs, milk and wool Fig Jr. buys.
exchange.noFarm: Fig Jr. buys what a homestead makes, and you don’t have one yet.
exchange.cap: Fig Jr. has bought all the {what} he can take from you today.
exchange.busy: The sale didn’t go through. Nothing was sold, so try again in a moment.
exchange.keep: Sales are kept on your Banana Pass, and this device doesn’t have one yet.
